name: What are the common costs associated with selling a luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: What are the common costs associated with selling a luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selling a luxury condo, common costs include real estate commissions, title insurance, attorney fees, transfer taxes, and potential HOA estoppel fees. You might also consider costs for pre-sale repairs or professional staging to enhance your property's value. Kelby Contreras provides a detailed breakdown of all potential selling costs upfront, ensuring transparency and helping you prepare financially. Understanding these expenses allows for better financial planning throughout the sale process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common costs when selling a luxury condo include commissions, title fees, taxes, and potential staging or repair expenses.
